passages.text: The hand of the LORD was upon me, and He brought me out by His Spirit and set me down in the middle of the valley, and it was full of bones.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD placed His hand on me.
The LORD acted with power.
The LORD used His Spirit to guide me.
The LORD brought me out by His Spirit.
The LORD set me down in the middle of a valley.
The valley was full of bones.
passages.original: הָיְתָ֣ה עָלַי֮ יַד־ יְהוָה֒ וַיּוֹצִאֵ֤נִי בְר֙וּחַ֙ יְהוָ֔ה וַיְנִיחֵ֖נִי בְּת֣וֹךְ הַבִּקְעָ֑ה וְהִ֖יא מְלֵאָ֥ה עֲצָמֽוֹת׃

passages.text: He led me all around among them, and I saw a great many bones on the floor of the valley, and indeed, they were very dry.
passages.sermon:
The LORD led me around the valley.
He showed me many bones on the ground.
There were a great number of bones.
The bones covered the floor of the valley.
The bones were very dry.
passages.original: וְהֶעֱבִירַ֥נִי עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם סָבִ֣יב׀ סָבִ֑יב וְהִנֵּ֨ה רַבּ֤וֹת מְאֹד֙ עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י הַבִּקְעָ֔ה וְהִנֵּ֖ה יְבֵשׁ֥וֹת מְאֹֽד׃

passages.text: Then He asked me, “Son of man, can these bones come to life?” “O Lord GOD,” I replied, “only You know.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to me.
He called me "son of man."
He asked me a question.
He said, "Can these bones live?"
I answered Him.
I said, "O Lord GOD, only You know."
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם הֲתִחְיֶ֖ינָה הָעֲצָמ֣וֹת הָאֵ֑לֶּה וָאֹמַ֕ר אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִ֖ה אַתָּ֥ה יָדָֽעְתָּ׃

passages.text: And He said to me, “Prophesy concerning these bones and tell them, ‘Dry bones, hear the word of the LORD!
passages.sermon:
God spoke to me.
He gave me a command.
He told me to speak to the bones.
He said, “Prophesy about these bones.”
He told me to say to them, “Dry bones, listen to the word of the LORD.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י הִנָּבֵ֖א עַל־ הָעֲצָמ֣וֹת הָאֵ֑לֶּה וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם הָעֲצָמוֹת֙ הַיְבֵשׁ֔וֹת שִׁמְע֖וּ דְּבַר־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: This is what the Lord GOD says to these bones: I will cause breath to enter you, and you will come to life.
passages.sermon: The Lord GOD spoke to the dry bones.\r\nThe Lord GOD said, “I will put breath into you.”\r\nYou will come to life.”
passages.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה לָעֲצָמ֖וֹת הָאֵ֑לֶּה הִנֵּ֨ה אֲנִ֜י מֵבִ֥יא בָכֶ֛ם ר֖וּחַ וִחְיִיתֶֽם׃

passages.text: I will attach tendons to you and make flesh grow upon you and cover you with skin. I will put breath within you so that you will come to life. Then you will know that I am the LORD.’ ”
passages.sermon:
The Lord God spoke to the dry bones.
He said, "I will attach tendons to you."
I will make flesh grow on you.
I will cover you with skin.
I will put breath inside you.
You will come to life.
You will know that I am the Lord."
passages.original: וְנָתַתִּי֩ עֲלֵיכֶ֨ם גִּדִ֜ים וְֽהַעֲלֵתִ֧י עֲלֵיכֶ֣ם בָּשָׂ֗ר וְקָרַמְתִּ֤י עֲלֵיכֶם֙ ע֔וֹר וְנָתַתִּ֥י בָכֶ֛ם ר֖וּחַ וִחְיִיתֶ֑ם וִידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: So I prophesied as I had been commanded. And as I prophesied, there was suddenly a noise, a rattling, and the bones came together, bone to bone.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD spoke to Ezekiel.
Ezekiel was a prophet.
God commanded Ezekiel to speak to the dry bones.
I obeyed God’s command.
I spoke as God told me.
As I spoke, I heard a sound.
There was a loud noise.
The bones began to move.
The bones came together.
Each bone joined to its matching bone.
passages.original: וְנִבֵּ֖אתִי כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר צֻוֵּ֑יתִי וַֽיְהִי־ ק֤וֹל כְּהִנָּֽבְאִי֙ וְהִנֵּה־ רַ֔עַשׁ וַתִּקְרְב֣וּ עֲצָמ֔וֹת עֶ֖צֶם אֶל־ עַצְמֽוֹ׃

passages.text: As I looked on, tendons appeared on them, flesh grew, and skin covered them; but there was no breath in them.
passages.sermon:
Ezekiel saw a vision from God.
He looked at the bones.
Tendons appeared on the bones.
Flesh grew on the bones.
Skin covered the bones from above.
There was no breath in the bodies.
passages.original: וְרָאִ֜יתִי וְהִנֵּֽה־ עֲלֵיהֶ֤ם גִּדִים֙ וּבָשָׂ֣ר עָלָ֔ה וַיִּקְרַ֧ם עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם ע֖וֹר מִלְמָ֑עְלָה וְר֖וּחַ אֵ֥ין בָּהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Then He said to me, “Prophesy to the breath; prophesy, son of man, and tell the breath that this is what the Lord GOD says: Come from the four winds, O breath, and breathe into these slain, so that they may live!”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to me.
He called me "son of man."
He told me to prophesy to the breath.
He said, "Prophesy, son of man."
He told me to speak to the breath.
He said, "This is what the Lord GOD says."
He said, "Breath, come from the four winds."
He said, "Breathe into these slain people."
He said, "Let them live."
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י הִנָּבֵ֖א אֶל־ הָר֑וּחַ הִנָּבֵ֣א בֶן־ אָ֠דָם וְאָמַרְתָּ֨ אֶל־ הָר֜וּחַ כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֣ר׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה מֵאַרְבַּ֤ע רוּחוֹת֙ בֹּ֣אִי הָר֔וּחַ וּפְחִ֛י בַּהֲרוּגִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה וְיִֽחְיֽוּ׃

passages.text: So I prophesied as He had commanded me, and the breath entered them, and they came to life and stood on their feet—a vast army.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Ezekiel.
God commanded Ezekiel to prophesy to the dry bones.
Ezekiel obeyed God.
Ezekiel prophesied as God commanded him.
Breath entered the bodies.
The bodies came to life.
They stood up on their feet.
They became a very large army.
passages.original: וְהִנַּבֵּ֖אתִי כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֑נִי וַתָּבוֹא֩ בָהֶ֨ם הָר֜וּחַ וַיִּֽחְי֗וּ וַיַּֽעַמְדוּ֙ עַל־ רַגְלֵיהֶ֔ם חַ֖יִל גָּד֥וֹל מְאֹד־ מְאֹֽד׃ס

passages.text: Then He said to me, “Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel. Look, they are saying, ‘Our bones are dried up, and our hope has perished; we are cut off.’
passages.sermon:
God spoke to me.
He called me "son of man."
He explained the meaning of the bones.
These bones are the whole house of Israel.
The people of Israel are speaking.
They say, "Our bones are dried up."
They say, "Our hope is gone."
They say, "We are cut off."
passages.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֮ אֵלַי֒ בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם הָעֲצָמ֣וֹת הָאֵ֔לֶּה כָּל־ בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הֵ֑מָּה הִנֵּ֣ה אֹמְרִ֗ים יָבְשׁ֧וּ עַצְמוֹתֵ֛ינוּ וְאָבְדָ֥ה תִקְוָתֵ֖נוּ נִגְזַ֥רְנוּ לָֽנוּ׃

passages.text: Therefore prophesy and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘O My people, I will open your graves and bring you up from them, and I will bring you back to the land of Israel.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD spoke to Ezekiel.
The Lord called Ezekiel "son of man."
The Lord told Ezekiel to prophesy to the people of Israel.
The Lord said, "This is what I, the Lord GOD, say."
The Lord called the people "My people."
The Lord said, "I will open your graves."
The Lord said, "I will bring you up from your graves."
The Lord said, "I will bring you back to the land of Israel."
The Lord promised to restore His people to their land.
passages.original: לָכֵן֩ הִנָּבֵ֨א וְאָמַרְתָּ֜ אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם כֹּֽה־ אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֒ הִנֵּה֩ אֲנִ֨י פֹתֵ֜חַ אֶת־ קִבְרֽוֹתֵיכֶ֗ם וְהַעֲלֵיתִ֥י אֶתְכֶ֛ם מִקִּבְרוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם עַמִּ֑י וְהֵבֵאתִ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם אֶל־ אַדְמַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס

passages.text: Then you, My people, will know that I am the LORD, when I open your graves and bring you up from them.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the people of Israel.
God called them His people.
God said, "I will open your graves."
God said, "I will bring you up from your graves."
God said, "You will know that I am the LORD."
God said this to His people.
passages.original: וִֽידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֑ה בְּפִתְחִ֣י אֶת־ קִבְרֽוֹתֵיכֶ֗ם וּבְהַעֲלוֹתִ֥י אֶתְכֶ֛ם מִקִּבְרוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם עַמִּֽי׃

passages.text: I will put My Spirit in you and you will live, and I will settle you in your own land. Then you will know that I, the LORD, have spoken, and I will do it, declares the LORD.’ ”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is speaking to His people Israel.
The LORD says, "I will put My Spirit in you."
You will live because of My Spirit.
I will settle you in your own land.
You will know that I am the LORD.
I have spoken these words.
I will do what I have said.
This is the declaration of the LORD.
passages.original: וְנָתַתִּ֨י רוּחִ֤י בָכֶם֙ וִחְיִיתֶ֔ם וְהִנַּחְתִּ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם עַל־ אַדְמַתְכֶ֑ם וִידַעְתֶּ֞ם כִּי־ אֲנִ֧י יְהוָ֛ה דִּבַּ֥רְתִּי וְעָשִׂ֖יתִי נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃פ

passages.text: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying, “And you, son of man, take a single stick and write on it: ‘Belonging to Judah and to the Israelites associated with him.’ Then take another stick and write on it: ‘Belonging to Joseph—the stick of Ephraim—and to all the house of Israel associated with him.’
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to me again.
He said these words to me.
He called me “son of man.”
He told me to take one stick.
He told me to write on the stick.
I must write, “Belonging to Judah and to the Israelites with him.”
He told me to take another stick.
He told me to write on the second stick.
I must write, “Belonging to Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and to all the house of Israel with him.”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃ וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן־ אָדָ֗ם קַח־ לְךָ֙ עֵ֣ץ אֶחָ֔ד וּכְתֹ֤ב עָלָיו֙ לִֽיהוּדָ֔ה וְלִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל חֲבֵרוֹ וּלְקַח֙ עֵ֣ץ אֶחָ֔ד וּכְת֣וֹב עָלָ֗יו לְיוֹסֵף֙ עֵ֣ץ אֶפְרַ֔יִם וְכָל־ בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל חֲבֵרוֹ׃

passages.text: Then join them together into one stick, so that they become one in your hand.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Ezekiel.
God called Ezekiel "son of man."
God told Ezekiel to take two sticks.
One stick represented Judah and the Israelites with him.
The other stick represented Joseph, Ephraim, and the Israelites with him.
God told Ezekiel to bring the two sticks close together.
Ezekiel must join the two sticks into one stick.
The two sticks will become one stick in Ezekiel’s hand.
passages.original: וְקָרַ֨ב אֹתָ֜ם אֶחָ֧ד אֶל־ אֶחָ֛ד לְךָ֖ לְעֵ֣ץ אֶחָ֑ד וְהָי֥וּ לַאֲחָדִ֖ים בְּיָדֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: When your people ask you, ‘Won’t you explain to us what you mean by these?’
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Ezekiel.
Ezekiel was a prophet.
God told Ezekiel to take two sticks.
God told Ezekiel to write on the sticks.
The people saw Ezekiel with the sticks.
The people were Israelites.
The people asked Ezekiel a question.
They said, "Will you tell us what these things mean for you?"
passages.original: וְכַֽאֲשֶׁר֙ יֹאמְר֣וּ אֵלֶ֔יךָ בְּנֵ֥י עַמְּךָ֖ לֵאמֹ֑ר הֲלֽוֹא־ תַגִּ֥יד לָ֖נוּ מָה־ אֵ֥לֶּה לָּֽךְ׃

passages.text: you are to tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel associated with him, and I will put them together with the stick of Judah. I will make them into a single stick, and they will become one in My hand.’
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He says this to the people of Israel.
God will take the stick of Joseph.
Ephraim holds this stick.
The tribes of Israel are joined with Ephraim.
God will take the stick of Judah.
God will join the stick of Judah to the stick of Joseph.
God will make them into one stick.
They will become one in God’s hand.
passages.original: דַּבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵהֶ֗ם כֹּֽה־ אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֒ הִנֵּה֩ אֲנִ֨י לֹקֵ֜חַ אֶת־ עֵ֤ץ יוֹסֵף֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּיַד־ אֶפְרַ֔יִם וְשִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל חֲבֵרוֹ וְנָתַתִּי֩ אוֹתָ֨ם עָלָ֜יו אֶת־ עֵ֣ץ יְהוּדָ֗ה וַֽעֲשִׂיתִם֙ לְעֵ֣ץ אֶחָ֔ד וְהָי֥וּ אֶחָ֖ד בְּיָדִֽי׃

passages.text: When the sticks on which you write are in your hand and in full view of the people, you are to tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘I will take the Israelites out of the nations to which they have gone, and I will gather them from all around and bring them into their own land.
passages.sermon:
Ezekiel is a prophet of God.
God speaks to Ezekiel.
God gives Ezekiel a message for the Israelites.
Ezekiel holds sticks in his hand.
Ezekiel writes on these sticks.
The people see the sticks in Ezekiel’s hand.
God tells Ezekiel to speak to the people.
God says, “I am the Lord GOD.”
God says, “I will take the Israelites from among the nations.”
The Israelites have gone to these nations.”
God says, “I will gather the Israelites from all around.”
God says, “I will bring the Israelites into their own land.”
passages.original: וְהָי֨וּ הָעֵצִ֜ים אֲ‍ֽשֶׁר־ תִּכְתֹּ֧ב עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם בְּיָדְךָ֖ לְעֵינֵיהֶֽם׃ וְדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם כֹּֽה־ אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֒ הִנֵּ֨ה אֲנִ֤י לֹקֵ֙חַ֙ אֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִבֵּ֥ין הַגּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָֽלְכוּ־ שָׁ֑ם וְקִבַּצְתִּ֤י אֹתָם֙ מִסָּבִ֔יב וְהֵבֵאתִ֥י אוֹתָ֖ם אֶל־ אַדְמָתָֽם׃

passages.text: I will make them one nation in the land, on the mountains of Israel, and one king will rule over all of them. Then they will no longer be two nations and will never again be divided into two kingdoms.
passages.sermon:
God is speaking to the people of Israel.
God will make the people of Israel into one nation.
This nation will be in the land of Israel.
This land includes the mountains of Israel.
One king will rule over all the people.
The people will not be two nations anymore.
They will never again be divided into two kingdoms.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֣יתִי אֹ֠תָם לְג֨וֹי אֶחָ֤ד בָּאָ֙רֶץ֙ בְּהָרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּמֶ֧לֶךְ אֶחָ֛ד יִֽהְיֶ֥ה לְכֻלָּ֖ם לְמֶ֑לֶךְ וְלֹ֤א יִהְיֶה עוֹד֙ לִשְׁנֵ֣י גוֹיִ֔ם וְלֹ֨א יֵחָ֥צוּ ע֛וֹד לִשְׁתֵּ֥י מַמְלָכ֖וֹת עֽוֹד׃

passages.text: They will no longer defile themselves with their idols or detestable images, or with any of their transgressions. I will save them from all their apostasies by which they sinned, and I will cleanse them. Then they will be My people, and I will be their God.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the Israelites.
They will not defile themselves anymore.
They will not worship idols.
They will not use detestable images.
They will not commit any of their past sins.
I will save them from all the places where they sinned.
I will cleanse them.
They will be My people.
I will be their God.
passages.original: וְלֹ֧א יִֽטַמְּא֣וּ ע֗וֹד בְּגִלּֽוּלֵיהֶם֙ וּבְשִׁקּ֣וּצֵיהֶ֔ם וּבְכֹ֖ל פִּשְׁעֵיהֶ֑ם וְהוֹשַׁעְתִּ֣י אֹתָ֗ם מִכֹּ֤ל מוֹשְׁבֹֽתֵיהֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָטְא֣וּ בָהֶ֔ם וְטִהַרְתִּ֤י אוֹתָם֙ וְהָיוּ־ לִ֣י לְעָ֔ם וַאֲנִ֕י אֶהְיֶ֥ה לָהֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: My servant David will be king over them, and there will be one shepherd for all of them. They will follow My ordinances and keep and observe My statutes.
passages.sermon:
God will appoint His servant David as king over the people.
David will rule over them.
There will be one shepherd for all the people.
The people will follow God's ordinances.
They will keep God's statutes.
They will do what God commands.
passages.original: וְעַבְדִּ֤י דָוִד֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וְרוֹעֶ֥ה אֶחָ֖ד יִהְיֶ֣ה לְכֻלָּ֑ם וּבְמִשְׁפָּטַ֣י יֵלֵ֔כוּ וְחֻקֹּתַ֥י יִשְׁמְר֖וּ וְעָשׂ֥וּ אוֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: They will live in the land that I gave to My servant Jacob, where your fathers lived. They will live there forever with their children and grandchildren, and My servant David will be their prince forever.
passages.sermon:
God gave land to His servant Jacob.
Your fathers lived in this land.
The people will live in this land.
Their children will live there.
Their grandchildren will live there.
They will live there forever.
My servant David will be their prince forever.
passages.original: וְיָשְׁב֣וּ עַל־ הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָתַ֙תִּי֙ לְעַבְדִּ֣י לְיַֽעֲקֹ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָֽשְׁבוּ־ בָ֖הּ אֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם וְיָשְׁב֣וּ עָלֶ֡יהָ הֵ֠מָּה וּבְנֵיהֶ֞ם וּבְנֵ֤י בְנֵיהֶם֙ עַד־ עוֹלָ֔ם וְדָוִ֣ד עַבְדִּ֔י נָשִׂ֥יא לָהֶ֖ם לְעוֹלָֽם׃

passages.text: And I will make a covenant of peace with them; it will be an everlasting covenant. I will establish them and multiply them, and I will set My sanctuary among them forever.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Israel.
God will make a covenant of peace with them.
This covenant will last forever.
God will establish the people.
God will cause them to grow in number.
God will place His sanctuary among them.
His sanctuary will remain with them forever.
passages.original: וְכָרַתִּ֤י לָהֶם֙ בְּרִ֣ית שָׁל֔וֹם בְּרִ֥ית עוֹלָ֖ם יִהְיֶ֣ה אוֹתָ֑ם וּנְתַתִּים֙ וְהִרְבֵּיתִ֣י אוֹתָ֔ם וְנָתַתִּ֧י אֶת־ מִקְדָּשִׁ֛י בְּתוֹכָ֖ם לְעוֹלָֽם׃

passages.text: My dwelling place will be with them; I will be their God, and they will be My people.
passages.sermon:
God is speaking about His people Israel.
God will live among them.
God will be their God.
They will be His people.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֤ה מִשְׁכָּנִי֙ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וְהָיִ֥יתִי לָהֶ֖ם לֵֽאלֹהִ֑ים וְהֵ֖מָּה יִֽהְיוּ־ לִ֥י לְעָֽם׃

passages.text: Then the nations will know that I the LORD sanctify Israel, when My sanctuary is among them forever.’ ”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD sanctifies Israel.
The LORD will place His sanctuary among Israel forever.
The nations will see the LORD’s sanctuary among Israel.
The nations will know that the LORD sanctifies Israel.
passages.original: וְיָֽדְעוּ֙ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה מְקַדֵּ֖שׁ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בִּהְי֧וֹת מִקְדָּשִׁ֛י בְּתוֹכָ֖ם לְעוֹלָֽם׃ס
